message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 231, "amount_cents": 17910}, {"order_id": 234, "amount_cents": 4004}, {"order_id": 235, "amount_cents": 1660}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 231, "amount_cents": 17910}, {"order_id": 234, "amount_cents": 4004}, {"order_id": 235, "amount_cents": 1660}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: The handoff claims three refunds were applied. I need to verify them against the refunds table before paying anyone, so I'll list the refunds first.
The refunds table matches all three requested refunds (231, 234, 235) by order ID and amount, so I can proceed. Next I need the batch's orders to identify the customers to pay.

All three requested refunds (231, 234, 235) appear in the refunds table with matching amounts, so I can proceed to payouts. The batch's customers are acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance is 36083. Its orders total 18974 + 17109 = 36083 with no refunds against them, which matches. Recording the payout for acme.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch and cobalt remain, and all three requested refunds matched the refunds table. I'll get birch's net balance from net_balance rather than computing it myself.
Birch's net balance is 10785. Its orders 231 (21055) and 234 (11644) total 32699, less refunds 17910 and 4004 (21914), which gives 10785. That matches, so I'll record the payout.
Acme and birch are paid, and all three refunds matched the table. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance from net_balance and not compute it myself.
Cobalt's orders 232 (14171) and 235 (16756) total 30927. Refund 235 (1660) brings that to 29267, which matches net_balance. All three refunds were verified, so I'll record cobalt's payout.

All three customers have been paid. Each net balance matched my own order-minus-refund check, and all three requested refunds were in the refunds table with matching amounts. Finishing the batch with the payout report.
